title: Most-Valuable Items and Insurance List
dataSources: Collection items (`collection:item`), vinyl plays (`vinyl:play`), LEGO sets (`lego:set`), trading-card prices (`tradingcard:price`).
app: Collection catalogues and price APIs — Discogs (vinyl), BrickLink (LEGO), trading-card and coin/stamp price feeds, and personal inventory databases with NFC-tagged scans — streamed to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=collection:item
| stats latest(market_value) as value, latest(condition) as condition by item category
| where value>100
| sort - value
description: Lists your most valuable collectibles with their condition, ready-made for an insurance schedule.
value: A current high-value list is exactly what an insurer wants and what you would need after a fire or theft.
implementation: Ingest item values into `index=personal`; schedule and surface items above a value threshold for insurance.
visualization: Table of highest-value items with condition and category.
grandmaExplanation: It lists your most valuable collectibles, which is exactly what you need for insurance or after a burglary.
